'''Faint yellow diamonds''' are precious [[gem]]s found as small [[cluster]]s in [[kimberlite]]. [[yellow diamond|Yellow]], [[red diamond|red]], [[black diamond|black]], [[blue diamond|blue]], [[clear diamond|clear]], and [[green diamond|green]] diamonds can be found as single gems within the clusters of faint yellow diamonds.
